softwarePath.meaning: Select the PLC or HMI software path returned by the tree for this target; station names can differ.

hmiSoftwarePath.meaning: Select the HMI software path in the current project.

blockPath.meaning: Use the returned block path, including user groups, relative to the program-block root.

typePath.meaning: Use the exact PLC data type path returned by the target software.

processId.meaning: Choose the process that contains the requested project from current process discovery.

projectName.meaning: Existing project: select its reported name. Creating a project: use the requested new name.

expectedProjectFile.meaning: Use the exact bound project file from the current session.

expectedProject.meaning: Use the current project identity returned by this engine.

devicePathJson.meaning: JSON STRING containing the exact device path name array; preserve each path segment.

itemPathJson.meaning: JSON STRING containing the item hierarchy beneath the selected device.

screenName.meaning: Use an existing screen name for edits; the requested new name for creation.

tagTableName.meaning: Use a table name/path in the selected software; names belong to that software.

pgPcInterface.meaning: Use an available transfer route interface for the intended target.

targetIpAddress.meaning: Use the intended device address from the selected route/discovery.

expectedToken.meaning: Copy the token from this same tool's preview with the same target and proposed content.

expectedPlanHash.meaning: Copy the plan hash from this same operation's preview.

expectedInventoryHash.meaning: Copy the inventory hash returned by the operation's preview.

exportId.meaning: Copy the exportId returned by the original tool; GetExportContent pages use its nextOffset.

ResponseMessage: Read meta.success / meta.operationSuccess when present; message supplies operation detail.
Tool-specific result keys are documented in the tool description.
ResponseStringList: items contains the returned rows or strings; meta supplies status and paging when present.
ResponseXmlBuild: xml contains generated XML. data contains builder details; generating XML does not import it into TIA.
default: Read the returned data fields and status using the resultContract below.
ResponseCompile: Check state, errorCount, warningCount and messages. Native compiler diagnostics, including child messages, are flattened by this wrapper.
meta.nodes preserves nested diagnostic context; inspect meta.effectiveState and incomplete. Root and subtree counts overlap; do not sum them.
ResponseCompileDiagnose: Check state and errorCount, then errors/warnings/info and rawMessages. These include nested native compiler diagnostics.
meta.nodes preserves nested diagnostic context; inspect meta.effectiveState and incomplete. Root and subtree counts overlap; do not sum them.
ResponsePlcProgramImport: Compare importedBlocks/importedTypes/importedTagTables with requested objects, inspect failed entries and compile.errorCount when compile was requested. A dryRun result is a plan.
Envelope: Read ok and error.code together with meta.outcome, execution and completeness.
Paging is in meta.paging. Batch data.items retain each target result unchanged; inspect failures and NOT_EXECUTED items.
TargetResult: CallTool returns the target result unchanged. Read GetToolUsage for that target.
Bridge admission failures use a V4 envelope with meta.execution=not-started.

ManageStartdriveParameter.input: devicePathJson and itemPathJson are JSON strings of names from GetProjectTree. Select the intended drive object from ReadDriveObjects. parameter is the exact parameter name, including index.

resultCases.meaning: DriveParameter reference: this is the configured connection source, not its live numeric value.
Scalar value of the selected offline engineering parameter, not a sampled live process value.
No accessible value. The API can return null for an invalid connection or inaccessible source; null does not prove the connection is unwired.

ManageStartdriveParameter.precaution: dryRun=true still reads native Value; it controls writes. p2051[0] has a reported TIA crash with native regression acceptance NOT RUN. Do not replay a failing read automatically; preserve the native invocation log and target details.

ImportFromDocuments.input: For FC_Add_SD.s7dcl (+ FC_Add_SD.s7res), importPath is the containing directory and fileNameWithoutExtension is FC_Add_SD.
ImportFromDocuments.result: This wrapper checks native State internally. Its public response reports meta.success, existsVerified and verifyDetail; contentVerified=null is not a content match. Native failures include imported-name/message details in the error. ManagePlcBlockDocuments exposes a structured native document result when that is required.

ManagePlcBlockDocuments.result: For import, inspect meta.result state, imported object names and native messages. Compare the requested object names with the returned set, then inspect the target group and compile; an empty imported set does not prove the requested content was imported.
ManagePlcBlockDocuments.resultReading: Read ok, error, meta.outcome, meta.execution and meta.completeness; independent quality and native evidence remain in data.

ExchangeUnifiedScriptModules.input: Global module exchange uses a directory package exported by the selected TIA release. Keep the .hmi.js, .hmi.yml and companion files together. moduleName is for export only.
ExchangeUnifiedScriptModules.result: Import: inspect meta.nativeSuccess and reported post-import module names. A successful native import is not independent content/compilation verification.

SetUnifiedHmiButtonEventScriptCode.input: scriptCode is the handler body of the named button/event; globalDefinitionAreaScriptCode is that handler's global definition area, not a global module package.
SetUnifiedHmiButtonEventScriptCode.result: A missing syntaxErrorCount means the optional native syntax check was not run. Inspect the write response and a separate HMI compile result.

resultCases.meaning: No compile errors, but inspect warnings. Success does not imply saved/downloaded.

CompilePlcDiagnostics.result: Read the typed fields shown in resultContract and meta.effectiveState, meta.rootCounts and meta.nodes. The wrapper traverses native child diagnostics recursively. A missing count is unknown, not zero; root/subtree counts overlap and must not be added. meta.incomplete/truncated/collectFailures explain partial diagnostics.

error.message: The hardware operation did not establish a successful result.

resultCases.meaning: The API returned, but a nested diagnostic establishes compilation failure even when root counts are zero.

CompileDevice.result: Compilation evidence is under data: effectiveState, rootCounts, errors, warnings and nodes, including nested diagnostics. The V4 outcome uses effectiveState, so a nested error remains failed even when root counts are zero. apiCallSuccess only means the API returned. incomplete, truncated and collectFailures describe partial diagnostics; root/subtree counts overlap and must not be added. behaviorPolicy remains current; no save/download is implied.
